rows.en: Touya: "Wh-Where am I...?"
Yamato: "Touya! Look!"
Debish: "Welcome, Touya."
Yamato: "Oh!"
Touya: (Debish... But what's this? I feel a power
that's beyond comparison with last time...)
Debish: "Hehehehe...
At last, the day has come for our purpose to be fulfilled..."
Touya: "Like hell it will. Give Ymir back right now!"
Debish: "Heh..."
Bernst: "Ymir is in the safest place of all.
Though the pilot does have a few personality problems."
Lyle: "...Shut up."
Touya: "? What do you mean? Don't tell me..."
Bernst: "Yes. Inside the Rayode.
You may not know this, but the Rayode offers the best protection
of the six ≪Ze=Ode≫ mechs here."
Touya: "Six?"
Debish: "Ah, of course.
You believed the Rayblade was the only thing
capable of opposing us.
But the only things that can wound our mechs
are other ≪Ze=Ode≫ mechs.
Is that not simple logic?
It seems the information was not passed on correctly.
Or perhaps it was deliberately concealed..."
Touya: "What...? This Rayblade is a ≪Ze=Ode≫ too...
I see. So that's why..."
Yamato: "Don't tell me you lured the Rayblade here, meow?"
Touya: "Yeah. They said if all six gather, the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫
can be triggered..."
Bernst: "You remembered well.
That is correct."
Touya: "But if we beat you bastards before then..."
Debish: "Hahaha! How amusing.
Just how much do you know?
Do you know how that explosion occurred,
the method behind it?"
Touya: "Well..."
Debish: "Besides, as you are now, you cannot defeat me.
This is not like last time. There is an absolute difference.
Yes, an absolute one...
Surely you can sense that better than anyone?"
Touya: "...Grr."
Clovis: "Touya!"
Arthur: "...Are you all right?!"
Xiujian: "There is no water... Impressive technology..."
Debish: "Now, enough talk. First, let me see once more
just how much you have grown."
Sharl: "Doctor?!"
Debish: "A diversion. Never mind it. You are all to stand back."
Bernst: "Let us obey for now. You too, Lyle."
Lyle: "...Tch. Well, fighting would be difficult in this situation anyway."
Sharl: "...Understood."
Sharl: "..."
Debish: "...Now then, let us set the rules.
Which will happen first: You wipe out all these Gadrans,
or I wipe out all of you? How does that sound?"
Touya: "You selfish..."
Debish: "Hehehe... Well, you have no choice in the matter.
Come at me!"
Yamato: "For now, let's focus on defeating the Gadrans, meow!"
Touya: "Yeah. I can feel some unknown power in him now.
If we attack carelessly, we'll be in danger."
Arthur: "Understood."
Clovis: "Those Gadrans look different from the ones we've fought before too."
Xiujian: "In any case, we have no choice but to do it."
Debish: "Hmm. It seems you have become reasonably capable.
Still, you are no match for me.
Well? Would you care to lend us your strength?"
Touya: "I refuse!! What the hell do you think human lives are?!
Like hell I'll help bring disaster on the world!"
Debish: "Disaster... It seems you still do not understand."
Touya: "What!?"
Debish: "...Why did we appear in this era?
Why did we only begin to act now...?
Well, there was a slight miscalculation."
Touya: "What are you trying to say?"
Debish: "The 'growth of humanity' Wenimas believed in,
the 'heart'... To see what those truly amounted to,
heaven had granted one final chance.
But for your own desires, you continued to fight
and would not stop hating one another...
Frankly, I am disappointed.
That is why I will carry out liberation through Vorlia.
So long as humanity retains its 'individuality,'
its only future is destruction."
Touya: "You selfish bastard... Who the hell do you think you are?!"
Debish: "Hehehehe... Who indeed?
I am myself... But I am 'one who guides Vorlia'..."
Touya: "Guides... Vorlia...?"
Debish: "Yes, Vorlia.
That which makes people equal beings.
You could call it a 'vessel of wisdom'..."
Touya: "You're not making any damn sense..."
Debish: "I do not particularly expect you to understand.
Judgment will now descend upon foolish humanity...
That is all."
Touya: "What...? You think you've become a god or something?!"
Debish: "Heh... Just what a common man would think.
I do not believe I have become a god, nor do I intend to become one.
I merely wish to save humanity.
To free it from the shackles of the flesh and unite it as a disembodied consciousness.
Through Vorlia, humanity will advance to a new stage."
Touya: "I won't let you have your way!"
Debish: "Heh... You will regret this, boy."
Touya: "Heh! Try it if you can!"
Debish: "Very well... Then I shall show you
the other power of the Goderius...
Hehehehe... Come, Vorlia, here!"
Debish: "Hehehe... How futile..."
Touya: "What?!"
Debish: "This was once a ≪Ze=Ode≫ research institute,
a fact you seem to have forgotten..."
Yamato: "I don't really understand it, meow, but the surrounding energy
is gathering in the Goderius!"
Touya: "The Rayblade's the same as his, isn't it?!
Why's it only happening to him?!"
Yamato: "How should I know, meow?!
Anyway, let's concentrate on defeating the Gadrans!"
Touya: "U-Understood."
Debish: "I am telling you, it is futile..."
